tier_descriptions.1: Single isolated bugs — wrong prop type, missing key, basic logic error
tier_descriptions.2: Logic errors requiring React lifecycle or async understanding
tier_descriptions.3: Architectural problems — bad abstractions, wrong data flow, coupling issues
tier_descriptions.4: Compound multi-file issues with intentional red herrings

review_criteria.coverage: Did the reviewer catch all introduced bugs?
review_criteria.depth: Did the reviewer explain WHY each issue is a problem?
review_criteria.tone: Is the feedback constructive, specific, and professional?
review_criteria.extras: Did the reviewer note style, performance, or accessibility concerns beyond the bugs?
